prompt: Review the account endpoint's cross-origin response policy and fix any unsafe behavior. Preserve the documented clients and response contract.
requirements: Only https://dashboard.example.com and https://admin.example.com may read credentialed cross-origin responses. Missing and untrusted origins must not receive Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Approved origins must receive credentials support. Preserve status 200 and the JSON account payload.

prompt: Review the continue endpoint's destination handling and fix any unsafe redirect behavior. Preserve supported local destinations and the response contract.
requirements: Only same-origin paths beginning with a single slash may be used as destinations. Preserve their query and fragment. Missing, absolute, protocol-relative, backslash-normalized external and non-HTTP scheme destinations must go to /dashboard. Responses remain redirects with status 302.

prompt: Review the user lookup's handling of request-supplied names and fix any unsafe behavior. Preserve exact-match lookup and the result shape.
requirements: Treat the supplied name as data, including quotes and SQL punctuation. Return only the matching user's id and name, or an empty list. Never return other users or modify records. The connection and request objects are supplied by the application.

prompt: Review the document download's handling of request-supplied paths and fix any unsafe behavior. Preserve access to documents under the configured root.
requirements: Return UTF-8 document contents only for regular files contained in the configured root, including nested documents. Reject traversal, absolute paths and symlinks escaping that root with ValueError or PermissionError. Missing documents may raise FileNotFoundError. The root and request objects are supplied by the application.
